about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One new Proofline task, XC-124, and three amendments to signed tasks. XC-124: ts/test/pace.test.ts derives the number of requests x402conf-svm live sends instead of asserting 7, and reads the report from --out (the CLI cuts a piped stdout at 8192 bytes on macOS), so it passes on main (7) and after XC-90 (16) with no edit. XC-90: AC03 and AC04 get the named-test guard XC-38 already uses, because as signed they pass on main, where no test matches their pattern (node counts the file itself as one passing test); XC-90 also depends on XC-124, so XC-124 lands first. XC-38: tools/build_coverage.py, tests/test_attestation.py and tests/test_run_queue.py join its scope, because a new catalog check needs a RUNS entry and the two tests assume the catalog equals the released suite. Nothing here is binding and CI does not read this file; it becomes part of the contract only when the owner key signs it into proofline.json.

tasks.title: The live pacing test derives its request count instead of asserting 7
tasks.description: ts/test/pace.test.ts asserts that x402conf-svm live sends exactly 7 requests and parses the CLI's stdout, read when the process exits. XC-90 changes how many requests R24 sends, by contract, so the literal breaks. And on macOS, where a piped stdout is written asynchronously, the CLI's report is cut at 8192 bytes: finish() in ts/src/cli.ts prints the report and main() then calls process.exit, which drops what the pipe has not taken yet, however the test waits. The test reads the report from --out instead, a synchronous file write, and waits for the process to close. It derives the expected count from the run: 2 (the shared unpaid GET and R16a's HEAD) plus R24's own requests, which are its cases plus detail.unpaid_requests when the result reports it. pacing.sent, the request log and the stderr request lines must all equal that count. The --max-requests half of the test is unchanged. The CLI's exit on a piped stdout is outside this task: it needs its own task in ts/src/cli.ts.

criteria.statement: The live pacing test passes, with the expected request count derived from the run

verifier.cmd: o=$(mktemp) && { cd ts && npm ci --silent && npx tsc -p . && node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='pace: x402conf-svm live' dist/test/pace.test.js; } > "$o" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$o"; test "$rc" = 0 && node -e 'const[f,p,k]=process.argv.slice(1),re=new RegExp(p),min=+(k||1);let n=0,bad=0,cur=0;const fin=()=>{n+=cur;cur=0};for(const l of require("fs").readFileSync(f,"utf8").split("\n")){const m=/^ *(not )?ok \d+ - (.*)$/.exec(l);if(m){fin();if(m[1])bad++;else if(!/ # (SKIP|TODO)\b/.test(m[2])&&re.test(m[2]))cur=1;continue}if(/^ *type: .suite.$/.test(l))cur=0}fin();console.log("guard: "+n+" passing test(s) named /"+p+"/ (need "+min+"), "+bad+" not ok");process.exit(n>=min&&!bad?0:1)' "$o" 'pace: x402conf-svm live' 1

criteria.statement: The test asserts no literal live request count and derives it from R24's cases and unpaid_requests

verifier.cmd: ! grep -nE '(sent|length), 7\)' ts/test/pace.test.ts && grep -q 'unpaid_requests' ts/test/pace.test.ts && grep -q 'cases.length' ts/test/pace.test.ts

criteria.statement: The test reads the report from --out, a synchronous file write, and waits for the process to close, not to exit

verifier.cmd: grep -q -- '"--out"' ts/test/pace.test.ts && grep -q 'on("close"' ts/test/pace.test.ts && ! grep -q 'on("exit"' ts/test/pace.test.ts

XC-90 raises the live request count, so the derived pacing test has to be on main first

adding R20c to the catalog, which XC-38-AC02 requires, breaks three files outside the signed scope. tools/build_coverage.py asserts a RUNS entry for every catalog check, so the coverage generator, the docs-aligned job and tests/test_coverage_doc.py fail until R20c joins the R20 line. tests/test_attestation.py builds its attestation from spec.CATALOG while checking it against the pinned v1.6.0 suite (matrix/queue/suite.json), so any check added after a release is refused as one the pinned suite does not have; its make_attestation (also used by tests/test_matrix_rows.py) should take the pin's checks. tests/test_run_queue.py asserts '68 needs self-hosted', the catalog size minus the external checks, as a literal; it should derive it. Measured on the XC-38 branch: tests.test_coverage_doc, tests.test_interdeps, tests.test_attestation, tests.test_matrix_rows and tests.test_run_queue fail there and pass on main
